decision: Completed-arc citation clearance is a published closed grammar plus a position predicate, read through one parser

alternativesConsidered.option: Widen CITE_RE to tolerate surrounding markup
Keep the strict bare-digit grammar and refuse decorated ids loudly

whyWinner: A three-critic panel on #3831 refuted widening 3/3: the parser already admits fenced, blockquoted and negated occurrences and already fail-opens the table guard, so a broader accept set is a net safety regression. Strictness was refuted too: a whole phrase inside a code span already parses while a backticked id does not, and there is no author predicate, so strictness buys no oracle strength. Publishing a closed set and classifying match position closes both halves and narrows the accept set on net.
revisitTrigger: A second measured field refusal on a decorator outside the published set, or an in-tree synthesis emitter that would make a generated wire format viable
